name: Parker County, TX
findings: Parker County has 403 nonprofit organizations. 138 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 109 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Parker County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list membership
observations.text: 15 social and fraternal organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 35 would.

confidence.text: Based on 35 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through social and fraternal groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 35 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
